objective: Align the R64 game_classification_icons write policy with the other admin tables (JWT app_metadata.role = admin OR public.users.role = admin) and show the error code/message when an icon save fails.
acceptance_criteria: Step 1 (DB+UI): a re-runnable migration replaces the 'Admin manage classification icons' policy with the JWT-or-users.role admin condition used by the other admin tables; SCHEMA.sql, sql/README.md and TESTS.sql (users.role-only admin can write, normal user denied) are updated; the admin icon dialog shows the Supabase error code and message on non-23514 failures; tsc, lint, git diff --check and the full Vitest suite pass.

Step 2 (review): Base..Target static review of the policy (no user_metadata, no client-side checks, self-promotion still blocked by prevent_users_role_self_change), artifacts written, main merge, user applies the migration and re-tests the icon save.
